description: When is the next US PPI (Producer Price Index) release? Returns the next release date and time in US Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default), its reference month, and the following scheduled PPI dates (up to 12). Source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics PPI schedule page. Gives dates only, not the index values. (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_ppi_release
